summary: ERC-7913 签名验证器进入 Final，让智能账户可验证任意密钥类型的签名。SirSpudlington 把 EIP-7932 迁移到新注册表，提交并合并。Titan、Ultrasound、ETHGas 与 EF 作者联合发文，指出 PBS 在定价、激励、集中度、延迟与开放性上留有空白。

summary_en: ERC-7913 signature verifiers moved to Final, letting smart accounts verify signatures for any key type. SirSpudlington migrated EIP-7932 to a new registry, submitted and merged. Authors from Titan, Ultrasound, ETHGas and the EF wrote that PBS leaves gaps in pricing, incentives, concentration, latency and openness.
